sessionHours.source: The owner shared the centre's 'Guida Operativa Capo Turno' in chat, page 20 'Orari della scuola'; local only, under data/knowledge/guida-ct/, not committed.
sessionHours.note: The timetable is the whole school's, Deriva and Cabinati courses that stay at a base. Hours are whole hours, end excluded: the morning outing counts 9:00 to 12:59 and is shown from 8:00 to 13:59. Itinerant courses (C4, C5) keep their own rhythm.

ownerChoice.said: Afternoon 14 to 19; the morning too one hour longer than the real session, to get a better idea of the trend.
ownerChoice.reading: Every number Vento says about an outing (wind, gust, sky, temperatures, thunder, 'In corso', and when the next outing becomes the answer) comes from the outing's own hours, 9:00 to 12:30 and 15:00 to 18:00. The hour row and the map show one hour more on each side, greyed, to read the trend: 8 to 14 and 14 to 19. A first build counted the whole window; review round four showed it moved the headlines to hours nobody sails, so the two were split on 2026-11-12. Logged in docs/working/OWNER_DECISIONS.md.
